attributes.action: Make ADHD Medication Accessible on the NHS Without Discrimination
attributes.additional_details: Shared Care for ADHD varies across NHS regions, leaving many patients without access to medication if they were diagnosed privately. This inconsistency is harmful and discriminatory. The Government should create a national standard requiring all ICBs to accept Shared Care for clinically stable ADHD patients.
attributes.background: Require all NHS Integrated Care Boards to offer Shared Care agreements for clinically stable ADHD patients, including those diagnosed privately, so they can access essential medication without discrimination.

rejection.details: Decisions to enter shared care agreements are a decision for individual NHS trusts, NHS consultants and GPs, not the UK Government or Parliament.
